diagram_previews.alt: Side view of the square pyramid: a triangle with apex V, height H and half-base s/2. Two blue circles of radius 6 rest on the base, centres O1 on the right, and a red circle of radius 6 centred O2 sits above them. The right side line l is tangent to the circles about O1 and O2; dashed radii of length 6 meet it at right angles, and a gray dashed segment joins O1 and O2.
